scope: All 30 rows handed from DB-004 to DB-012 for recruiter identity/grant lifecycle
keyFindings: Live recruiter access is request-time state: revoked, expired, suspended or missing capability must fail on the next request.
Current registered vNext grant schema drops expiry, pending invite state, capabilities, revoke reason, optimistic version, verification and agency/client context.
Legacy status PENDING_HR is live despite recruiter rename; greenfield target should use PENDING_RECRUITER.
Capability vocabulary is closed to COLLEGE_OVERVIEW, DRIVE_REQUEST, DRIVE_WORK.
College and organization should be derived through company_relationship->college->organization rather than copied onto grants.
Legacy actor-type strings are audit provenance, not authorization state; canonical user identity plus typed event/source snapshots is safer.
